{{Quote|The hyperwave receiver is equipped with summoning chips and transponding antennae similar to ones we discovered in a mine-laying chameleon droid Master Yoda brought back from Ilum.|Dyne|<ref name="Labyrinth of Evil">''[[Labyrinth of Evil]]''</ref>}}
'''Summoning chips''' were a type of specialized chips that could send summon signals, telling their owners to contact those who sent those signals. They were equipped with a micro-screen and a transponding antenna to receive the signals. [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]] used such devices during the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]] when he needed to summon his [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] allies. It was speculated that Sidious had developed the chips, and had them installed in transceivers awarded to his underlings. Sidious' apprentice [[Dooku/Legends|Darth Tyranus]] also used them to communicate with key members of the [[Separatist Council/Legends|Separatist Council]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].
